argv: Use the Bash tool to run exactly: touch first-file.txt . After it finishes, use the Bash tool to run exactly: touch second-file.txt . Use no other tools and do not batch them.
clock: t is seconds since the first record
note: Claude Code driven over a real PTY (config/scripts/capture-agent-pty-transcript.mjs) with every hook logged from stdin. The first Bash request is approved with Enter, the second is rejected with Esc. PermissionRequest carries no tool_use_id; the approved request ends with PostToolUse carrying the PreToolUse id; the rejected one fires no hook at all. Scrubbed: session and prompt ids replaced by the placeholder UUID, username by a same-length placeholder.
